plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for C-Data access device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, temperature, fan, and interface traffic, for C-Data GPON and EPON OLT (enterprise PEN 34592).
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Device CPU utilization from sysCpuUtilization, reported directly as a percentage (Integer32 0-100).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature from chassisTemperature. The Unsigned32 value is reported as Celsius with no extra scale.

metrics.name: psu_a_on
metrics.description: Power supply A on bit from powerStatusBit (bit 0). Value 1 means on and 0 means off.

metrics.name: psu_b_on
metrics.description: Power supply B on bit from powerStatusBit (bit 1). Value 1 means on and 0 means off.

metrics.name: fan_status_bitmap
metrics.description: Chassis fan status bitmap from fanStatusBit. Bit 0 is fan 1, bit 1 is fan 2, bit 2 is fan 3, and bit 3 is fan 4, each with 1 meaning on.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
